title: anim.follow_through/1
description: data/anim/follow_through.json: how a blow's body carries on after the contact (docs/animation/follow-through.md; AnimFighter._follow_carry and the handover in _exchange_layers). pieces: for each listed key set `drive` is how many units further forward the body is drawn and `dip` how many it sinks, peaking a third of the way through `ticks` and settled by the end (both zero on the contact tick); a row may carry its own `release_deg`. handover_ticks: when the next blow's wind-up takes the window while the last blow's contact solve is still in force, the solve lets go over this many ticks instead of on one. release_deg: the most the striking arm's upper arm may turn in a tick after the contact of a listed blow. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

handover_ticks.description: Ticks over which the last blow's contact solve lets go when the next blow's wind-up takes the window.

release_deg.description: The most the striking arm's upper arm may turn in a tick after the contact (degrees).

drive.description: Units further forward the body is drawn at the peak of the carry.

dip.description: Units the body sinks at the peak of the carry.

ticks.description: The carry's length in ticks: it peaks a third of the way through and is settled by the end.

release_deg.description: This blow's own most the upper arm may turn in a tick after the contact (degrees).
